card.name: Pharmacist and dispensing words in labels
card.fires_on: Words about dispensing and medication handling in drug labels, such as pharmacist, dispensed, Medication Errors and Drug Interactions headings. It often sits on the first part of a split word.

modes.label: Pharmacist and dispensing
modes.description: The word pharmacist or the start of dispensed, where a drug is handed to the patient.
modes.example: receive from their pharmacist every time an opioid analgesic is<< disp>>ensed to them.

modes.label: Medication error and interaction headings
modes.description: Parts of heading phrases like Medication Errors or Drug-Drug Interactions.

card.writes: It pushes toward prescription-related words such as prescriptions, prescribing and prescribe.
card.plain: It lights up on pharmacist and dispensing wording and predicts that talk of prescriptions comes next.
